title: Checks for missing from __future__ import annotations imports upon detecting type annotations that can be written more succinctly under PEP 563.
summary: PEP 585 enabled the use of a number of convenient type annotations, such as liststr instead of Liststr. However, these annotations are only available on Python 3.9 and higher, _unless_ the from __future__ import annotations import is present. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-future-annotations and made it stable in v0.0.269.

title: Checks for uses of PEP 585- and PEP 604-style type annotations in Python modules that lack the required from __future__ import annotations import for compatibility with older Python versions.
summary: Using PEP 585 and PEP 604 style annotations without a from __future__ import annotations import will cause runtime errors on Python versions prior to 3.9 and 3.10, respectively. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-future-annotations and made it stable in v0.0.271.

title: Checks for FastAPI routes that use the optional response_model parameter with the same type as the return type.
summary: FastAPI routes automatically infer the response model type from the return type, so specifying it explicitly is redundant. Ruff takes this rule from FastAPI and made it stable in 0.8.0.

title: Identifies FastAPI routes with deprecated uses of Depends or similar.
summary: The FastAPI documentation recommends the use of typing.Annotated for defining route dependencies and parameters, rather than using Depends, Query or similar as a default value for a parameter. Using this approach everywhere helps ensure consistency and clarity in defining dependencies and parameters. Ruff takes this rule from FastAPI and made it stable in 0.8.0.

title: Identifies FastAPI routes that declare path parameters in the route path that are not included in the function signature.
summary: Path parameters are used to extract values from the URL path. Ruff takes this rule from FastAPI and made it stable in 0.10.0.
